system.description:
• Effect: +1 AC while wearing light armour or no armour and carrying no shield. Does not stack with other unarmoured bonuses of the same kind.
  • An additional +1 at 7th, 13th, and 19th levels
  • AC bonus by level: +2 total at 7th, +3 at 13th, +4 at 19th.

rules.when: light or no armour and no shield
